answer_1.quote: We finetune MINIMA on instruction-following data and get MINICHAT. The instruction-following data covers a broad collection of both single-turn question-answering pairs and multi-turn conversation sessions, which totally adds up to 1.1M examples.
answer_1.outputs: instruction-following responses in single-turn and multi-turn conversations

answer_2.quote: We evaluate MINIMA against an extensive set of baselines on several standard benchmarks including MMLU, CEval, DROP, BBH, and HumanEval.

answer_3.quote: We compare MINICHAT to some instruction-following LMs on Vicuna-Bench and BELLE-bench, which demand GPT4 for pairwise assessments.

answer_4.quote: To further simplify the arena, we attain the models responses to questions in the dataset in advance. During the whole process, model identities are anonymized from humans. Multiple experienced researchers are recruited to mitigate human biases.
answer_4.guideline: The arena quickly reduces the evaluation complexity from O(#models×#questions) to O(#questions).
